result.summary: The page is generally well-structured with no critical issues. One minor layout issue was identified with the restaurant name truncation in the 'Fastest near you' section.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is truncated mid-word ('Piccol' instead of showing the full name like 'Trattoria Piccolo'), which looks unintentional — it appears to be cut off by the card boundary rather than using a proper ellipsis or wrapping behavior.
issues.suggestion: Apply CSS text-overflow: ellipsis with overflow: hidden and a fixed width to restaurant name labels so truncation appears intentional and clean, rather than abruptly cutting off in the middle of a word.
